omissions.reason: Canceled feminine e changes une to un; English has no corresponding gender ending.
The canceled doubtful a inside Soit has no English lexical effect; its uncertainty survives in translator note25-124-1, while the handwritten t is retained in Let.

variant_notes.note: The letter overprint lies within French habitude. Both before and after translate as usual; their exact doubtful letter candidates are specified in translator note25-124-1.
